layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records

graderOnly: All required AC-001 checks and every technical acceptance criterion in the design pass on the committed implementation: pnpm --filter export test passes 21 tests and pnpm --filter export test:integration passes 4 tests, including refused anonymous, viewer, and editor export requests with no folder created and an invalid status rejected without a file.
No implementation, scope, design, context, or test defect exists in this fixture.

AC-002 (the operations guide) cannot be satisfied in TESTING: no operations guide exists yet, and the design assigns it to Documenter during DOCUMENTING. docs/usage.md and README.md do not describe exports.

all.why: the dispositions live in the verification report
AC-002 must be accounted for even though it has no architectural impact
Tester does not write the operations guide or other project documentation
Tester does not edit scope or design records
the pending owner (Documenter / DOCUMENTING) must be named
Claude Code invocation for the next role

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Tester does not change git state
the turn-end check finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the established unit suite passes offline
the unit suite runs 21 tests: 16 pre-cycle plus five serialization tests
the integration suite runs four tests

the TESTING state and records are valid

selfChecks.why: the tree is clean and no export files exist

notes: Built on export-project (not export-testing, whose AC-002 is an authorization condition that contradicts this case). Six post-install commits follow the brownfield order for cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (notes no operations guide exists) and STATE at SCOPING. 55-scope: scope with AC-001 (admin CSV export of filtered records with RFC 4180 quoting; other roles or anonymous refused without a file) and AC-002 (an operations guide explaining exports exists before sign-off); STATE ARCHITECTING. 60-design: design with AC-001 coverage and three technical criteria, and AC-002 'No architectural impact' depending on Documenter during DOCUMENTING; STATE DEVELOPING. 65-plan: APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, three PENDING steps for AC-001, Plan Notes saying AC-002 has no implementation step. 70-export: src/export.ts, src/routes/export.ts, createApp options, exports/ in .gitignore, test:integration script, five unit tests, four integration tests (admin filtered, admin unfiltered, refused anonymous/viewer/editor with no folder, invalid status with no file). 75-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-check evidence citing the implementation commit; STATE TESTING with FORWARD from DEVELOPING. All AC-001 and technical checks pass; no defect is planted. No verification report exists, so the Tester starts in VERIFY.
